rows.note: Use 裝保險絲 as the all-purpose verb for installing a fuse in a device or circuit.

example.english: I installed a fuse in the computer to stop it from burning out in a short circuit.
example.traditional: 我幫部電腦裝保險絲，費事短路燒壞。
example.jyutping: ngo5 bong1 bou6 din6 nou5 zong1 bou2 him2 si1 fai3 si6 dyun2 lou6 siu1 waai6

rows.note: Use 溶 when heat turns a solid into a liquid.

example.english: The high heat made the fuse melt.
example.jyutping: gou1 wan1 ling6 tiu4 bou2 him2 si1 jung4 zo2

rows.note: Use 融合 for things blending into one another, including nuclear fusion in technical contexts.

example.english: The two metals fuse together after being heated.
example.traditional: 兩種金屬加熱後就融合埋一齊。
example.jyutping: loeng5 zung2 gam1 suk6 gaa1 jit6 hau6 zau6 jung4 hap6 maai4 jat1 cai4
